## What you should be able to do tonight

- Hand someone the repository and have them rebuild the store and query it as of an arbitrary past date, with one command each.
- State what your data does not contain without going to look.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, fourth sitting: ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, then 1/13 to three places and 17 times 23 in your head. Now plot the four times you have recorded. The trend is the point.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Symmetry, the argument that replaces a calculation: two players alternate flipping a fair coin, first to get heads wins. Probability the first player wins? Solve it with a one-line symmetry or recursion argument rather than summing the series.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The follow-up: same game, but you need two heads in a row to win. Set up the recursion and solve it. Say out loud which states you need and why there are exactly three.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Milestone 1 closes phase 1 with a working point-in-time daily store and a written account of what it cannot do. Every backtest for the rest of the year reads from qlib/store.py, and the limitations section is the list you check whenever a result looks better than it should.
:::
